Viral Video Shows Dhoni and Pant at a Party

A video featuring cricketers MS Dhoni and Rishabh Pant at a party has gone viral on social media. The clip shows the players in a room, reportedly with friends. In the video, Dhoni is allegedly heard making a remark about smoking a hookah, which has sparked discussions. The exact date of the video is unconfirmed, but it also shows Kabir Bahia, a UK-based businessman linked to actress Kriti Sanon.
